speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Thank you for giving priority to our interests.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: We strongly oppose this option. Moving the wind park away from the coast is worse for marine biodiversity.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: It would threaten the breeding grounds of our seal colony.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: If you move the wind park, there is no other option than to position it outside Arcadia's territorial sea.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: That is problematic, because Arcadia does not have full sovereignty over the EEZ.
